name: ui/button
title: Button
summary: The registry button: a <button> that carries structure, state and ARIA only (data-slot, data-variant, data-size, data-state), with no styling class. Its look is styles/pattern/mzizi-theme.css; its minimums are styles/pattern/floor.css, reading styles/pattern/tokens.css.

props.name: variant
props.description: default wears --primary; destructive reads only the destructive token.

props.name: size
props.description: Heights are set by the stylesheet from the size roles: default 49px on touch and 36px drawn at desktop density, sm 49 / 32, lg 56 / 40, icon 49 / 36, icon-sm 49 / 32; each keeps the 49px (touch) or 28px (desktop) hit region.

behaviour: data-variant, data-size and data-state carry the variant, size and state. The component sets no styling class; `class` is a pass-through for the adopter's own classes.
Never below the Bundu hit region: 49px on touch, 28px on a desktop with a fine pointer, held by floor.css (the hit-area pseudo-element), not by the markup.
data-state is `disabled` when the native disabled attribute is set, `enabled` otherwise.

aria: aria-invalid shows the destructive ring; aria-expanded the open state.

theming.brandOverlay: The default variant follows the brand's `--primary` and the focus ring its `--ring`. Destructive never takes a brand colour. The look is styles/pattern/mzizi-theme.css, keyed on [data-slot="button"][data-variant], so an adopter brings its own theme against the same attributes.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

contract:
contract
  slot is "button"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/button"
end

checks.say: The button sets no styling class: the look is in the stylesheet.
The outline variant is marked on the element.
The small size is marked on the element.
Disabled is the native attribute, mirrored to data-state.
